title: Logit Leakage through Floating-Point Bias Addition
abstract: arXiv:2610.16790v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Language model APIs can expose token-specific biases while withholding logits and token probabilities. Existing bias-based extraction recovers relative logits, leaving a common additive component undetermined in ideal arithmetic. We identify a numerical side channel in floating-point bias addition that exposes information about this component through token identities alone. The channel distinguishes score vectors with identical complete unperturbed log probabilities. Our method exploits changes in representable spacing at binary exponent boundaries. Under the stated binary32 arithmetic assumptions and a known reachable score interval, it recovers a logit pair and its unknown tie-breaking priority exactly in at most 52 token queries. Given complete relative logits, one recovered anchor determines the original logit vector. translated_title: 通过浮点偏置加法导致的Logit泄露
translated_abstract: 语言模型API可以在不公开logit和token概率的情况下暴露特定token的偏置。现有的基于偏置的提取方法只能恢复相对logit，在理想算术条件下仍留下一个共同的加性分量无法确定。我们在浮点偏置加法中发现了一种数值侧信道，仅通过token的身份标识就能暴露该分量的相关信息。该信道能够区分那些具有完全相同的未扰动log概率的得分向量。我们的方法利用了二进制指数边界处浮点数可表示间隔的变化。在给定的binary32算术假设和已知的可达得分区间下，该方法最多通过52次token查询即可精确恢复一对logit及其未知的平局决胜优先级。在已知完整相对logit的情况下，只需一个恢复的锚点即可确定原始logit向量。我们在来自七个模型家族的11个公开检查点上评估了该恢复方法的效果，并通过自适应方法扩展了这一局部技术（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文发现了语言模型API中浮点偏置加法存在的数值侧信道漏洞，利用二进制指数边界处浮点精度的变化，最多仅需52次token查询即可精确恢复原本无法确定的logit加性分量。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies a numerical side channel in floating-point bias addition within language model APIs, exploiting representable spacing changes at binary exponent boundaries to exactly recover the previously undetermined additive logit component in at most 52 token queries.
